children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 15, 2026) - Hertz Energy Inc.
(OTCQB: HZLIF) (FSE: A340) ("Hertz" or the "Company") announces that further to its news release dated October 9, 2026, Coloured Ties Capital Inc.
("Coloured Ties") has agreed to participate in the Company's previously announced non-brokered private placement of up to $1,607,400 (the "Offering").

Coloured Ties, which currently holds 1,176,300 common shares of the Company, representing approximately 6.21% of the Company's issued and outstanding common shares, has agreed to subscribe for up to 2,777,777 HD Units at a price of $0.18 per HD Unit for gross proceeds of up to $500,000. The aggregate size of the Offering and the terms of the HD Units and the Warrants remain as announced on October 9, 2026.

Assuming completion of the Offering as announced, Coloured Ties is expected to hold 3,954,077 common shares of the Company, representing approximately 14.96% of the Company's issued and outstanding common shares on a non-diluted basis and approximately 23.05% on a partially diluted basis, assuming exercise of the Warrants comprising the HD Units subscribed for by Coloured Ties and no other issuances. The Offering will not result in a change of control of the Company.

Mr. Kal Malhi, the Chief Executive Officer and a director of the Company, is also the Chief Executive Officer and a director of Coloured Ties and beneficially owns, directly and indirectly, approximately 25.6% of the outstanding common shares of Coloured Ties. Mr. Malhi declared his interest and abstained from voting on the approval of Coloured Ties' participation in the Offering.
Related Party Transaction

Coloured Ties is a "related party" of the Company for the purposes of MI 61-101 on the basis that Mr. Malhi and his spouse together beneficially own, or exercise control or direction over, more than 50% of the outstanding common shares of Coloured Ties. Its participation in the Offering constitutes a "related party transaction" within the meaning of Multilateral Instrument 61-101 -
Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions

"). The Company is relying on the exemption from the formal valuation requirement in section 5.5(a) of MI 61-101 and the exemption from the minority shareholder approval requirement in section 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101, on the basis that neither the fair market value of the securities to be issued to Coloured Ties, nor the consideration to be paid by Coloured Ties, exceeds 25% of the Company's market capitalization.

The material change report in respect of Coloured Ties' participation in the Offering will not be filed at least 21 days before the anticipated closing date of the Offering because the participation of Coloured Ties was not settled until shortly before the date of this news release and the Company wishes to complete the Offering in an expeditious manner.

Completion of the Offering remains subject to certain conditions, including receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals, including the final approval of the Canadian Securities Exchange. All securities issued under the Offering, and any Warrant Shares issued on exercise of the Warrants, will be subject to a statutory hold period expiring four months and one day from the date of issuance of such securities.

The securities referred to in this news release have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "U.S. Securities Act"), or any state securities laws and may not be offered or sold within the United States or to, or for the account or benefit of, U.S. persons absent registration under the U.S. Securities Act and applicable state securities laws, unless an exemption from such registration is available. This news release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities.
About Hertz Energy Inc.

Hertz Energy is a British Columbia-based junior exploration company focused on the exploration at its Lake George Antimony and Tungsten Project, which is adjacent to the Lake George Antimony Mine, which has been tendered by the Province of New Brunswick to Agnico Eagles Critical Minerals Division, Avenir Minerals. Additionally, Hertz is exploring its Craig Silver project in the Yukon, which has a small indicated high grade mineral resource and has been underexplored. Hertz also owns the Agastya Lithium project amidst Lift Power's Adina and Galine Lithium project.
